title: Revamped Realms
description: a mod that adds various additions to the overworld.
body:
the revamped realms mod adds various new additions to the base game.
such as :


brand new desert vegetation:

![desert](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cea280522f33a330cff73c0595f3246a8969fe43.png)



brand new badlands vegetation:


![badlands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/90a2d46d892ec7f09fe627135dfe45eb1dcd4075.png)



brand new foods:


![foods](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/817aac45f844f7d4b0e43c3d0cbfc5e81f6c76f0.png)


beartraps:


![beartrap](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9bf272607a83e80cd7e78ee4a2a6a1f15f67c620.png)


strawberry bushes (birch forests):

![star](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e2aa1a0fa55f8ef8a6d70fcccb48c658b742f1d8.png)


venus flytraps (jungles):

![venus](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4e6c8eee3a6447c1714280f35386960d6fe80ef7.png)


abandoned saloon structure:


![abandoned](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3d541a6ff454f531abb756efb580e012069ad345.png)


new advancements:


![advancements](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/713105cc199424d8eb03acc9b8aa76592afd4ef7.png)


**⬆️these are some of the brand new features added in update 2.0.0⬆️**








































maple tree and wood set:




![maple tree](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4af4bca01e4cdf271daf71a4e2edbe6ba2ce7d29.png)
![maple wood set](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1aba4268e0d53c8eeafdb163fc9ae24b411f1f74.png)
![house showcasing the new blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/281f07a8c04645727b4c2db2d289ac716c269eb3.png)




blue oyster and wrinkled peach:




![blue oyster and fallen dark oak tree](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/60ddd0b1a5534e8f857ba2ae779afbb8cbb4247a.png)
![wrinkled peach mushroom](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e3c37e6b0aba18019fba09963f3741c51f35b148.png)




maple syrup and making:




![maple syrup](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1496a9cb701ac392b41d8d82fcb0eae817ebdf98.png)
![making maple syrup](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/53df6aed318d16f2fc8dbd11c39d823cd08c483c_0.webp)
(to get the orange bottle you have to right click the maple sap on maple trees with an empty glass bottle,it is **NOT** honey)




these are all the features as of update 2.0.0. beta
